purpose: Require conservative CPU screen-space proof before authorizing the sole v10f actual-GPU pocket close-up.

source_failure.root_cause: The 1 mm outer-edge lift adds one projected pixel to the first U-shoulder sample; every non-rim safety gate already passes.

rim.intent: Aim at the 12 px midpoint, not either hard edge.

sidewall.intent: Leave at least 4 px margin above the GPU median lower bound.

ordered_stage_columns.sampling_band: central 50% of columns that contain all three ownership roles

luma.calibration_anchor: Frozen v10d sidewall/void medians 25.294/2.0; interpolate v10f COLOR_0 through a conservative 0.55 encoded response exponent.

v10f_asset_contract.only_behavioral_delta_from_v10e: Set rim outer y equal to rim inner y (-0.006 m), replacing the v10e outer y of -0.005 m; no radial width or other geometry/material/camera value changes.
v10f_asset_contract.sidewall_color_ramp: COLOR_0 neutral scalar, frozen-camera smoothstep from 0.14 to 1.0 across screen y=840..855; object-ID ownership is unaffected
v10f_asset_contract.felt_cutout: corner=sqrt(2)*(void_back+rim_width), side=void_back+rim_width so the cloth cannot occlude the projected bowl

cpu_model_calibration_requirement.baseline: frozen v10d production glTF and REJECTED_MACHINE object-ID metrics

authorization_rule: Even a complete offline PASS does not authorize GPU execution. Root must independently review the deterministic report and explicitly authorize one v10f actual-GPU close-up.
